title: Camera flow fixed
details: Photo capture now uses the live camera frame immediately instead of waiting on the slow ImageCapture path seen on some Android phones
After Use photo, Evia goes straight to the required written explanation instead of showing another preview and Continue step
After guided video recording, Evia goes straight to the optional extra-text screen instead of briefly showing a black or broken media preview
The existing Evia evidence-page layout, 1:1 camera area, guided video prompts and timestamp recording are unchanged
summary: Evia v130 removes the long photo-capture delay and the extra broken preview step after captured evidence.
changes: Bypassed the slow Android ImageCapture frame path
Added automatic handoff from accepted photo to its explanation
Added automatic handoff from finished video to optional text
Preserved the Evia UI and staged evidence workflow
Moved the offline shell to v130
